attribute.name.extraspellattributes.cull: Threshold to Cull or Be Culled
attribute.name.extraspellattributes.aure: Physical Damage Mitigated Recouped as Reabsorption
attribute.name.extraspellattributes.diss: Dissolution Gained Per Damage Taken, for 4 seconds. You are at Maximum Health while in Dissolution.
attribute.name.extraspellattributes.inev: Inevitability gained per second. +10% Spell Crit Damage per Inevitability, up to +100%.
Strike an enemy with a precise melee attack for 1.5x damage. If you are under the effect of a concealment effect (Invisibility, Vanish...), consume the concealment to guarantee a critical strike. If the attack also critically strikes naturally, it ignores armor.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.suppres: Chance to Suppress Magic Damage, halving the damage taken. Chance above 100% can proc multiple times, multiplicatively. Stacks.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.warding: Gives Reabsorption: recharging yellow hearts. Stacks.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.glancin: Gives Evasion Rating. Every 15 Evasion Rating turns a hit taken into a Glancing Blow, dealing only 65% normal damage; leftover rating is a chance at one more. Procs stack multiplicatively. Glancing Blows can't come from non-entities. Stacks.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.mageban: Your armor reduces magic damage as if it were physical, but you take 20% increased damage after armor.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.imbalan: Physical hits are tripled, then reduced by your armor a second time. Strong armor turns this into mitigation; weak armor makes it a death sentence.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.battler: Some incoming damage is regenerated over the next four seconds. Stacks.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.aureate: Some physical damage prevented is regenerated as yellow hearts, up to maximum reabsorption. Gives some reabsorption. Stacks.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.endurin: Your Endurance reduces damage that would take you below 20% of your Maximum Life.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.dissolu: You gain Dissolution equal to the damage you take, lowering your Maximum Health until you take no damage for 4 seconds. You are always at maximum health while in Dissolution.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.etherea: You lose 95% of your health, but gain +5 and +100% Reabsorption.
enchantment.extraspellattributes.guerill: Dealing 150% of your attack damage within 1 second gives a chance to go Invisible for 4 seconds.
desc.extraspellattributes.glance: Every 15 Evasion Rating turns a hit taken into a Glancing Blow, dealing only 65% damage; leftover rating is a chance at one more. Multiple Glancing Blows stack multiplicatively. You cannot receive Glancing Blows from damage that doesn't come from an entity (Such as Fire and Poison).
desc.extraspellattributes.supp: A Suppressed Spell deals only 50% damage. Chance above 100% can proc multiple times, multiplicatively.
desc.extraspellattributes.determination: Your % Determination is the proportion of health lost that regenerates back over the next four seconds.
desc.extraspellattributes.reabsorption: You regenerate Absorption (Yellow Hearts) up to your maximum Reabsorption gradually after not being hit for 4 seconds.
